  [inst : SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV.Structure M]
  [hM :
    @FirstOrder.Language.Theory.Model SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV M inst
      SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Axioms.ACVF]
  {m : Nat} (S B : Set M)
  (f :
    @Set.Elem (@SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType M inst)
        (@SpecialTransformations.Section3.RVFibreConstancy.domain M inst B) →
      Fin m → M),
  (∀
      (a :
        @Set.Elem (@SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType M inst)
          (@SpecialTransformations.Section3.RVFibreConstancy.domain M inst B))
      (i : Fin m), @SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRV M inst (f a i)) →
    @SpecialTransformations.Section3.DefinableOver M inst S
        (@HAdd.hAdd Nat Nat Nat (@instHAdd Nat instAddNat) m (@OfNat.ofNat Nat (nat_lit 1) (instOfNatNat (nat_lit 1))))
        (@SpecialTransformations.Section3.MixedPolynomialSyntax.contextSort m)
        (@SpecialTransformations.Section3.RVFibreConstancy.graph M inst m B f) →
      @Set.Finite M
        (@Set.ofPred M fun t =>
          And (@Membership.mem M (Set M) (@Set.instMembership M) B t)
            (∃ a b,
              And
                (@Eq M
                  (@SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRv M inst
                    (@Subtype.val M (fun x => @SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iVF M inst x)
                      (@Subtype.val (@SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType M inst)
                        (fun x =>
                          @Membership.mem (@SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType M inst)
                            (Set (@SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType M inst))
                            (@Set.instMembership (@SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType M inst))
                            (@SpecialTransformations.Section3.RVFibreConstancy.domain M inst B) x)
                        a)))
                  t)
                (And
                  (@Eq M
                    (@SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iRv M inst
                      (@Subtype.val M (fun x => @SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.iVF M inst x)
                        (@Subtype.val (@SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.Transfer.VFType M inst)

                          b)))
                    t)

  (Q :

      (@Union.union (Set M) (@Set.instUnion M) S (@Set.range M (Fin n) a)) k m sn),
  ∃ H,
    And
      (@Set.Definable M S SpecialTransformations.Milestone0.LRV (@CanonicalStructure.normalize M sM)
        (Sum (Fin n) (Sum (Fin k) (Fin m)))
        (@Set.ofPred (Sum (Fin n) (Sum (Fin k) (Fin m)) → M) fun z =>
          @Membership.mem (Prod (Fin n → M) (Prod (Fin k → M) (Fin m → M)))
            (Set (Prod (Fin n → M) (Prod (Fin k → M) (Fin m → M))))
            (@Set.instMembership (Prod (Fin n → M) (Prod (Fin k → M) (Fin m → M)))) H
            (@Prod.mk (Fin n → M) (Prod (Fin k → M) (Fin m → M))
              (@Function.comp (Fin n) (Sum (Fin n) (Sum (Fin k) (Fin m))) M z (@Sum.inl (Fin n) (Sum (Fin k) (Fin m))))
              (@Prod.mk (Fin k → M) (Fin m → M)

                  (@Function.comp (Fin k) (Sum (Fin k) (Fin m)) (Sum (Fin n) (Sum (Fin k) (Fin m)))
                    (@Sum.inr (Fin n) (Sum (Fin k) (Fin m))) (@Sum.inl (Fin k) (Fin m))))
                (@Function.comp (Fin m) (Sum (Fin n) (Sum (Fin k) (Fin m))) M z
                  (@Function.comp (Fin m) (Sum (Fin k) (Fin m)) (Sum (Fin n) (Sum (Fin k) (Fin m)))
                    (@Sum.inr (Fin n) (Sum (Fin k) (Fin m))) (@Sum.inr (Fin k) (Fin m))))))))
      (And
        (∀ (v : Fin n → M) (b : Fin m → M) (t u : Fin k → @SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.Code M sM),
          @Eq (Fin k → @SpecialTransformations.Section3.Values.Gamma M sM hM)
              (@SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.values M sM hM k t)
              (@SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.values M sM hM k u) →

                (@Set.instMembership (Prod (Fin n → M) (Prod (Fin k → M) (Fin m → M)))) H

                  (@Prod.mk (Fin k → M) (Fin m → M) (@SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.rawTuple M sM k u)
                    b))))
        (∀ (c : Fin k → M) (b : Fin m → M),
          @SpecialTransformations.Section3.GammaParameters.Proper M sM k c →

                      (@SemilatticeInf.toPartialOrder β
                        (@Lattice.toSemilatticeInf β
                          (@DistribLattice.toLattice β (@instDistribLatticeOfLinearOrder β inst))))))
                  (f x) b)))
          (@LE.le Nat instLENat
            (@Set.ncard α
              (@Set.ofPred α fun x =>
                And (@Membership.mem α (Set α) (@Set.instMembership α) A x)
                  (@LT.lt β
                    (@Preorder.toLT β
                      (@PartialOrder.toPreorder β
                        (@SemilatticeInf.toPartialOrder β
                          (@Lattice.toSemilatticeInf β
                            (@DistribLattice.toLattice β (@instDistribLatticeOfLinearOrder β inst))))))
                    (f x) b)))
            N))
        (And
          (@Set.Finite α
            (@Set.ofPred α fun x =>
              And (@Membership.mem α (Set α) (@Set.instMembership α) A x)
                (Not
                  (@LT.lt β
                    (@Preorder.toLT β
                      (@PartialOrder.toPreorder β
                        (@SemilatticeInf.toPartialOrder β
                          (@Lattice.toSemilatticeInf β
                            (@DistribLattice.toLattice β (@instDistribLatticeOfLinearOrder β inst))))))
                    (f x) b))))
          (@LE.le Nat instLENat
            (@Set.ncard α
              (@Set.ofPred α fun x =>
                And (@Membership.mem α (Set α) (@Set.instMembership α) A x)
                  (Not
                    (@LT.lt β
                      (@Preorder.toLT β
                        (@PartialOrder.toPreorder β
                          (@SemilatticeInf.toPartialOrder β
                            (@Lattice.toSemilatticeInf β
                              (@DistribLattice.toLattice β (@instDistribLatticeOfLinearOrder β inst))))))
                      (f x) b))))
            N))) →
    @Set.Finite β (@Set.image α β f A)
